And Oth Counsel for Petitioner :- Srees Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
Shri Vimal Kumar, Advocate along with Shri Vinod Kumar, Advocate has filed power along with short counter affidavit on behalf of the informant/complainant, which is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State/respondent and learned counsel for the informant.

The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with the following main reliefs :-
Aniket Shukla @ Babu Shukla vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 15 February, 2024

entities.text: Aniket Shukla @ Babu Shukla vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari thereby quashing the impugned First information report lodged by the opposite party no.3 on the basis of false and fabricated facts on 14 12 2023 at Crime 278 of 2023, Under Section- 376,504,506,452, Indian Penal Code & section 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act, Police Station- Achalganj, District Unnao, contained in Annexure No.1 to this writ petition.

(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus thereby directing the opposite parties no 1 and 2 to not to take any action against the petitioner on the basis of the impugned First information report lodged by the opposite party no.3 at Crime 278 of 2023, Under Section-376,504,506,452, Indian Penal Code, & section 3(2)(V) S.C./S.T.Act, Police Station- Achalganj, District- Unnao, contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition.
Learned counsel for the petitioner says that even before lodging of the F.I.R., the petitioner had got married to the complainant.
The F.I.R. has been lodged only out of annoyance of the complainant with the petitioner.
Learned counsel for respondent no.3/complainant does not dispute the aforesaid contention.
He has filed a short counter affidavit bringing on record the application made to the Senior Superintendent of Police, Unnao.
A copy of which has been filed as Annexure No.SA-1 to the short counter affidavit.

The writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the Investigating Officer/respondent no.2 to look into the evidence that is produced by the respondent no.3/complainant with regard to her compromise, if any, with the petitioner and take an appropriate decision strictly in accordance with law within four weeks from the date of approach of the petitioner before him.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 A.Dewal  Aniket Shukla @ Babu Shukla vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ...
